translation: Acharya Umasvati — Nathmal Tatia & Sacred Texts Heritage

chapters.name: The Three Jewels of Liberation (Ratnatraya)
chapters.subtitle: Right faith, right knowledge, and right conduct

verses.text: Right faith (Samyak Darshana), right knowledge (Samyak Jnana), and right conduct (Samyak Charitra) together constitute the path to liberation.
Non-violence is the supreme religion (Ahimsa Paramo Dharmah). All living beings desire to live; no one wishes to be harmed or killed.
verses.original: अहिंसा परमो धर्मः । सर्वे जीवाः सुखमेधन्ते न कश्चिन्मरणं प्रियम् ॥
verses.transliteration: Ahiṁsā paramo dharmaḥ. Sarve jīvāḥ sukhamedhante...

verses.text: Souls render service to one another (Parasparopagraho Jivanam). Life is interdependent.
